book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Setɑm u Yesu kɔkurɑ
Yen biru Hunde Dɛɛro u kɑ Yesu dɑ ɡbɑburɔ Setɑm u kɑ nùn kɔkiri.
Ye Yesu u nɔɔ bɔkuɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ weeru kɑ wɔ̃kuru weeru, yen biru ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ nùn mɔ̀.
Mɑ Setɑm u nɑ win mi u nɛɛ, ɑ̀ n sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔn Biin nɑ, ɑ kpee nini sɔ̃ɔwɔ nu ɡɔsio pɛ̃ɛ.
Yesu nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔn ɡɑri yi ɡeruɑ yi nɛɛ, tɔnu kun ko n wɑ̃ɑ dĩɑnu tɔnɑn sɔ̃. U mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ Gusunɔn ɡere kpuron sɔ̃.
Mɑ Setɑm u kɑ nùn dɑ Yerusɑlɛmu wuu dɛɛrɔ ɡen mi, u nùn sɔndi sɑ̃ɑ yerun wii kpiirɔ.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ̀ n sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔn Biin nɑ, ɑ yɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ surɑ temɔ domi Gusunɔn ɡɑri yi ɡeruɑ yi nɛɛ,

content.text: “Gusunɔ u koo win ɡɔrɑdobɑ nɔɔ kɛ̃ wunɛn sɔ̃ bu nun nɛnɛ kɑ ben nɔmɑ,
kpɑ ɑ ku rɑ kɑ wunɛn nɑɑsu kperu sokurɑ.”

content: Yesu nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑdɑmɑ Gusunɔn ɡɑri yi mɑɑ ɡeruɑ yi nɛɛ, “A ku rɑ Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinnin dɑm mɛɛri ɑ kɑ wɑ mɛ mu nɛ.”
Yen biru Setɑm u kɑ Yesu dɑ ɡuu bɑkɑru ɡɑrun wɔllɔ, u nùn duniɑn tem kpuro sɔ̃ɔsi kɑ mɛn bɛɛrɛ mi sinɑmbɑ bɑndu dii.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, yeni kpurowɑ kon nun wɛ̃ ɑ̀ n yiirɑ ɑ mɑn sɑ̃wɑ.
Mɑ Yesu u wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doonɔ min di Setɑm. Domi bɑ yoruɑ bɑ nɛɛ, “Kɑɑ Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni sɑ̃, kpɑ ɑ n wi turon wɑ̃ɑru wɑ̃ɑ.”
Yerɑ Setɑm u doonɑ win min di, mɑ Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdobɑ bɑ nɑ bɑ nùn nɔɔri.
Yesu win sɔmburu toruɑ Gɑlileɔ
Ye Yesu u nuɑ mɑ bɑ Yohɑnu mwɑ bɑ doke pirisɔm sɔɔ, yerɑ u doonɑ Gɑlileɔ.
U ǹ sinɛ Nɑsɑrɛtiɔ, u dɑ u sinɑwɑ Kɑpenɑmuɔ, ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ dɑɑ burerun bɔkuɔ te bɑ rɑ soku Gɑlile, Nɛfitɑli kɑ Sɑbulonin temɔ.
Kpɑ ye Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Esɑi u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ yu kɑ koorɑ, ye u nɛɛ,

content.text: “Sɑbulonin tem kɑ Nɛfitɑlin tem mu wɑ̃ɑ nim wɔ̃ku ɡiɑ,
dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Yuudɛnin ɡuruɔ Gɑlileɔ mi tɔn tukobɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Be bɑ sɔ̃ yɑm wɔ̃kuru sɔɔ mi, bɑ koo yɑm bururɑm bɑkɑm wɑ.
Be, be ɡɔɔn bɛrum wukiri nɡe yɑm wɔ̃kuru,

content: Sɑɑ sɑɑ yen diyɑ Yesu u win wɑɑsu toruɑ. U nɛɛ, i bɛɛn ɡɔ̃rusu ɡɔsio, domi Gusunɔ u sisi u bɑndu swĩi.
Yesu u susure kowobu nnɛ sokɑ
Nɡe mɛ Yesu u sĩimɔ Gɑlilen dɑɑ burerun bɔkuɔ u susure kowobu yiru ɡɑbu wɑ, mɔɔ kɑ wɔnɔ, Simɔɔ wi bɑ rɑ soku Piɛɛ kɑ win wɔnɔ Andere. Bɑ susure mɔ̀ dɑɑ bure te sɔɔ kɑ yɑ̃ɑkororu.
Yesu u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i mɑn swĩimɑ, kon bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔsi nɡe mɛ i ko kɑ tɔmbu kɑsu bu mɑn swĩi.
Mii mii bɑ ben yɑ̃ɑkoronu deri, mɑ bɑ nùn swĩi.
Ye u susi wuswɑɑɔ u mɑɑ mɔɔ kɑ wɔnɔ wɑ Yɑkɔbu kɑ Yohɑnu, Sebeden bibu. Bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ben ɡoo nimkuu sɔɔ kɑ ben tundo Sebede, bɑ ben yɑ̃ɑkoronu kɔrumɔ. Yesu u bu sokɑ.
Mii mii bɑ ben tundo deri ɡoo nimkuu sɔɔ, mɑ bɑ Yesu swĩi.
Yesu u bɔsu Gɑlilen tem kpuro sɔɔ u keu sɔ̃ɔsimɔ ben mɛnnɔ yenɔ u bɑn te Gusunɔ u koo swĩin Lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑ wɑɑsu mɔ̀, mɑ u tɔmbu ben bɑrɑ bwese bwesekɑ bɛkiɑmmɛ.

Win bɑɑru yɑ yɛ̃bi bɑɑmɑ kpuro Sirin tem sɔɔ sere tɔmbɑ kɑ ben bɑrɔbu nɑ win mi, be bɑ bɑrɑ bwese bwesekɑ mɔ kɑ be bɑ wuriri dɑbinun wɑhɑlɑ mɔ̀ kɑ be bɑ wɛrɛkunu mɔ, kɑ ɡirikpɑkpɑ wɔrobu kɑ bèn wɑsin bee tiɑ ɡu ɡu. Mɑ Yesu u be kpuro bɛkiɑ.
Mɑ tɔn wɔru ɡuni nùn swĩi sɑɑ Gɑlile kɑ berɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ wusu wɔkurun di, kɑ Yerusɑlɛmu kɑ Yudeɑ kɑ tem mɛ mu wɑ̃ɑ dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Yuudɛnin ɡurun di.
